title.zh: 低重心準備：腳、髖與自由手
title.en: Ready balance: feet, hips and free arm

notes.zh: 林昀儒雙膝彎曲、身體前傾，拍子留在身體前方。這個形狀能往左右移動，不能只把腰折下去、腿保持直立。
notes.en: Lin bends the knees and leans forward with the paddle in front. This stance leaves room to move; bending only the waist would not reproduce it.

notes.zh: 自由手用來平衡身體，不是每板都固定端在胸前。張本遠端下半身受到球桌遮擋，此張不適合比較兩人的精確膝角。
notes.en: The free arm balances the body rather than staying fixed at the chest. The table obscures Harimoto’s lower body, so this frame cannot support exact knee-angle comparisons.

title.zh: 手肘留空間，擊球後仍能銜接
title.en: Space around the elbow supports the next stroke

notes.zh: 張本右臂呈緊湊彎肘，拍子靠近身體前方；林的左臂也保留彎曲。遊戲應表現肘先預備、前臂再送出，而非直臂左右甩。
notes.en: Harimoto’s right arm is compact and bent; Lin’s left arm also retains bend. The animation needs elbow preparation and forearm delivery rather than a rigid arm swinging sideways.

notes.zh: 林已回到較低的準備位置，兩腳提供支撐。這裡可看出還原不是把球拍突然拉回固定座標，而是全身重新準備。
notes.en: Lin has regained a low ready position with both feet supporting him. Recovery is a whole-body reset, not snapping the paddle back to one coordinate.

title.zh: 移動後回擊：腳步與自由手一起動
title.en: Movement and the free arm accompany the return

notes.zh: 林正在移動回擊，兩腳的位置改變，自由手向相反方向伸出來平衡；人物不能沿地板滑動、雙腳始終貼死。
notes.en: Lin changes his foot positions while the free arm extends to counterbalance the moving return. A character sliding with both feet glued down would miss this coordination.

notes.zh: 此張有明顯動態模糊，適合看全身動作方向；拍面、握拍和精確觸球位置無法由這張單圖確定。搭配前後影格與原片看動作。
notes.en: Motion blur makes this useful for whole-body direction, while paddle face, grip and precise impact remain unresolved. Read it together with adjacent frames and the source replay.

title.zh: 2018 張本：先調整支撐，再出拍

notes.zh: 黃衣遠端的張本向側邊來球移動，雙腳展開、右肘彎曲，前臂在胸前送出。請連看2:29.8–2:31.2，觀察到位、出拍和還原的順序。
notes.en: Far-side Harimoto in yellow moves laterally, widens his feet and delivers the bent right forearm in front of the chest. Read 2:29.8–2:31.2 together for positioning, delivery and recovery.

notes.zh: 這是2018年已有的全身協調例子，不能據單張影格說當年的反手使用率較高，也不能把較寬步幅解讀成退化。
notes.en: This illustrates coordination already present in 2018. One frame cannot establish a higher backhand rate or interpret a wider step as decline.

title.zh: 2019 林昀儒：台內接球要先移入
title.en: 2019 Lin: move into the table receive

notes.zh: 粉衣左手的林在遠端右側台角前移，上身降低、左肘彎曲，持拍手穿過胸前；前後影格可見接球後撤回較寬的準備站姿。
notes.en: Pink-shirted, left-handed Lin moves into the far right table corner, lowers the trunk and bends the left elbow as the racket travels in front of the chest. Adjacent frames show retreat into a wider ready stance.

notes.zh: 這段支持「前移接球→撤回準備」的動畫流程。手腕、拍面與旋轉未量測，不能單凭這張把接法定為擰拉或說接球直接得分。
notes.en: The sequence supports a move-in/receive/retreat animation. Wrist, paddle face and spin were not measured, so this frame alone cannot identify a flick or establish a direct receive winner.

title.zh: 2021 張本：緊湊反手與自由手
title.en: 2021 Harimoto: compact backhand and free arm

notes.zh: 橘衣遠端的張本降低胸口，右肘留在身體前方、前臂靠近胸腹，左手伸向另一側。下一段出拍和還原仍保持連續，而非直臂甩完停住。
notes.en: Far-side Harimoto in orange lowers the chest, holds the right elbow ahead of the body and keeps the forearm near the torso while the left hand extends away. Delivery and recovery continue rather than ending in a held rigid-arm swing.

notes.zh: 球桌遮住部分腿與拍子。這張可看胸肩、手肘和自由手的配合，不能估算腳掌接地、膝角或用力大小。
notes.en: The table obscures parts of the legs and paddle. This frame illustrates upper-body and free-arm coordination, not foot contact, knee angles or force.

title.zh: 2023 林昀儒：正手大揮拍的收拍
title.en: 2023 Lin: finish of a larger forehand swing

notes.zh: 黑衣近端的林左手收拍升高，胸口方向、屈膝支撐和右側自由手跟著變化；右手張本在遠端重新準備。引拍到收拍需要看1:04.4–1:10.0整段。
notes.en: Near-side Lin in black finishes with the left arm high, while trunk direction, flexed support and the free right arm change together. Right-handed Harimoto prepares again at the far side. Read 1:04.4–1:10.0 for the full preparation-to-finish sequence.

notes.zh: 這是慢動作重播，用來區分大幅正手與胸前短出拍。不能按播放秒數估算真正球速、揮拍速度或比2026年更有力量。
notes.en: This slow-motion replay distinguishes a larger forehand shape from a short chest-front stroke. Playback seconds do not establish real ball speed, swing speed or greater power than in 2026.

title.zh: 2026 張本：身側引拍後向前上出拍
title.en: 2026 Harimoto: forehand delivery after side preparation

notes.zh: 藍衣的張本右臂由身側較低位置向前上方送出，肩胸轉向，左側自由手展開；稍後收拍到頭部附近，再把拍子還原到身體前方。
notes.en: Blue-shirted Harimoto delivers the right arm forward and upward from a low position beside the body, turning the chest and opening the free left arm. Later frames show a head-height finish followed by recovery in front.

notes.zh: 球與拍在這個視角接近，但單張2D投影不能確認精確觸球。這是重播近景，下半身逐漸被裁去；腳步需搭配其他寬景樣本。
notes.en: Ball and paddle appear close in this projection, but one 2D frame cannot confirm exact impact. This close replay progressively crops the lower body; use wide samples for footwork.

title.zh: 張本正手：由低身側引拍到額旁收拍
title.en: Harimoto forehand: from a low side preparation to a finish near the forehead

caption.zh: 胸肩已偏轉，右肘留在身側；低位拍手部分被球桌遮住。
caption.en: The chest and shoulders are turned, with the right elbow beside the body; the low racket hand is partly hidden by the table.

caption.zh: 右前臂從低身側向前送，胸口同時轉動；接觸尚未確認。
caption.en: The right forearm drives forward from low beside the body as the chest turns; impact remains unconfirmed.

caption.zh: 拍手上收至額旁，肘仍彎曲，左自由掌在另一側張開。
caption.en: The racket hand rises beside the forehead, with the elbow still bent and the free left palm open on the other side.

caption.zh: 球拍已由頭旁降回桌前，胸口前傾銜接下一板；前景遮住部分軀幹。
caption.en: The racket has lowered from beside the head to the table front, with a forward lean into the next ball; the foreground player obscures part of the trunk.

limitations.zh: 慢動作倍率未知，這些秒數是來源影片時間；不得用影格間的播放秒差推估真實揮拍或擊球速度。
limitations.en: The slow-motion rate is unknown. These are source-video timestamps; playback time differences must not be used to estimate real stroke or ball speed.

limitations.zh: 出拍階段不是確證觸球影格；單角度投影、模糊及球的深度未知限制了接觸判讀。
limitations.en: The stroke phase is not a confirmed impact frame. Single-view projection, blur and unknown ball depth limit contact identification.

limitations.zh: 球桌與近景前景遮住部分拍手、軀幹和腿，足底出畫面；不量測 3D 關節角、髖肩時差、足底受力或完整步法。
limitations.en: The table and foreground close-up obscure parts of the racket hand, trunk and legs, and the feet are out of frame. No 3D angles, hip-to-shoulder timing, foot pressure or complete footwork are measured.

limitations.zh: 還原影格已銜接下一板來球，呈現由高位隨揮降拍的過程，不代表一個孤立、完全停止的準備姿勢。
limitations.en: The recovery frame already leads into the next incoming ball. It shows the racket lowering from a high finish, not an isolated, motionless ready pose.

title.zh: 2026 張本：反手的肘與前臂空間
title.en: 2026 Harimoto: elbow and forearm space in the backhand

notes.zh: 右肘保持彎曲、前臂在胸前作較短的向前動作，左手在另一側配合平衡。連看37:39.6–37:40.9，可見準備、送出和收回的連續變化。
notes.en: The right elbow stays bent as the forearm makes a shorter forward motion in front of the chest; the free left arm moves on the other side. Read 37:39.6–37:40.9 for preparation, delivery and withdrawal.

notes.zh: 和上方同場正手樣本相比，這段的引拍與收拍路徑不同，動畫需要各自設計。不同球種和鏡位不能用來證明跨年代打法比例或力量變化。
notes.en: Compared with the forehand sample from the same match, preparation and finish follow a different path and need distinct animation. Different strokes and views cannot establish era changes in shot share or power.

title.zh: 張本反手：胸前短出拍與回撤
title.en: Harimoto backhand: a compact stroke in front and withdrawal

caption.zh: 胸口略低，右肘彎曲，拍手收在胸前；左自由掌張開。
caption.en: The chest is slightly lowered, the right elbow bent and the racket hand held in front of the chest, with the free left palm open.

caption.zh: 右前臂短幅前送；球與拍面投影重疊，仍未確證觸球。
caption.en: The right forearm makes a short forward motion; the ball overlaps the racket face in projection, but impact is still unconfirmed.

caption.zh: 拍手向前下方完成短隨揮，自由臂向側方伸展。
caption.en: The racket hand completes a short forward-downward finish as the free arm extends to the side.

caption.zh: 右肘重新彎曲、拍手回到身前，左手降回側方。
caption.en: The right elbow bends again and the racket hand returns in front, while the left hand lowers beside the body.

limitations.zh: 慢動作倍率未知，這些秒數是來源影片時間；不得用影格間的播放秒差推估真實揮拍或擊球速度。
limitations.en: The slow-motion rate is unknown. These are source-video timestamps; playback time differences must not be used to estimate real stroke or ball speed.

limitations.zh: 出拍階段不是確證觸球影格；單角度投影、模糊及球的深度未知限制了接觸判讀。
limitations.en: The stroke phase is not a confirmed impact frame. Single-view projection, blur and unknown ball depth limit contact identification.

limitations.zh: 球桌與近景前景遮住部分拍手、軀幹和腿，足底出畫面；不量測 3D 關節角、髖肩時差、足底受力或完整步法。
limitations.en: The table and foreground close-up obscure parts of the racket hand, trunk and legs, and the feet are out of frame. No 3D angles, hip-to-shoulder timing, foot pressure or complete footwork are measured.

limitations.zh: 反手外形可辨，旋轉及 block／counter 分類沒有確認；不能因為拍球在畫面重疊而量測拍球 3D 距離。
limitations.en: The backhand shape is visible, but spin and block-versus-counter classification are unconfirmed. Screen overlap does not measure the 3D ball-racket distance.
